Hi — answering inline to the security questions and attaching a more detailed network diagram with ports: 

1) Telemetry / logs: Redwood does not log raw PII by default. We capture anonymized telemetry and request/response metadata for rate-limiting and billing; customers can opt out of request logging or configure redaction. Fields typically redacted by default: user identifiers (user_id), raw text bodies when customers enable PII redaction.

2) VPC model: We support both options: (a) dedicated subnet per customer (recommended for strict isolation), or (b) shared subnet with isolated ENIs and strict IAM/network policies. For procurement/legal, we recommend dedicated subnets or dedicated accounts for regulated workloads.

3) On-prem / air-gapped: During initial validation we require outbound only for signature verification and updates (HTTPS to specific Redwood update endpoints). We can perform initial validation in an offline mode with a signed artifact; post-validation we can support scheduled offline updates via customer-provided media. We will document exact endpoints/ports in the attached diagram.

Attached: redwood_vpc_deployment_diagram.png (detailed with ports/endpoints) and a prefilled VSQ (vendor_security_questionnaire_request_filled.docx).

- I'll attach the prefilled VSQ and the detailed diagram to a shared Drive link for infra procurement (link below).
- Let's book the 30-min tech deep-dive: Wed 3/10 10:30 PT works for our team.
